statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low because current European risk tone is firmer and persistent live NQ mean-reversion failure is not independently established; event proximity, post-Fed rates pressure and Middle East risk keep Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; the principal risk checkpoint is the 12:30 UTC U.S. release cluster and subsequent cash-open price discovery.
headline: European risk tone stays firmer while U.S. data proximity and post-Fed rates keep Stress extreme
body: Reuters reported European equities and technology firmer, oil lower and global bond yields flat-to-lower after the Fed hike, while U.S. futures remained modestly positive. Direct live NQ retracement quality is not independently verified, so current Tail stays low despite extreme event and macro Stress.

lookbackSummary: Across the prior 24 clock-hours, Tail rose into the FOMC sequence, peaked at 25% at 20:00 UTC on September 16, then decayed to 19% by 08:00 UTC on September 17 as the published assessment moved back toward mixed, lower-Tail conditions.
outlookSummary: Tail stays low conditionally through the European morning, rises into WATCH around the 12:30 UTC U.S. release cluster and cash-open discovery, then decays if price discovery becomes two-way. Post-Fed rates and geopolitical risks keep Stress elevated.

forecast.analysis: The closing phase stays low-Tail conditionally if directional extensions continue to retrace; unresolved post-Fed rates pressure keeps Stress elevated.
